subject: Prefer CLI-first operator workflows and CMD success chaining

payload.summary: Software-engineering operations should prefer CLI/API/scripts over browser UI when reliable automation exists. When Windows CMD commands are strictly sequential and should stop on first failure, provide a single copy-pasteable chain using &&; reserve & for unconditional sequencing and | for stdout piping.
